topic_title: Symmetric Encryption, Hashing and Key Storage

atoms.title: Encryption vs. hashing
atoms.objective: Distinguish encryption from hashing, explain the one-way property that makes them suited for different jobs, and choose the correct control when a scenario requires either confidentiality or integrity verification.

atoms.title: Symmetric encryption and key management
atoms.objective: Explain the mechanics of symmetric encryption, differentiate between ECB and secure modes of operation (like CBC and GCM), and describe the key lifecycle management principles necessary to protect keys from compromise.

atoms.title: Integrity and authenticity (HMAC)
atoms.objective: Explain why a plain hash cannot prove who sent a message, describe how HMAC combines a secret key with a hash function to provide both integrity and authenticity, and classify a given integrity-check design as secure...
